notes.title: Content Update V0.180001
notes.content:
1. Added enemy factions by which enemies are categorized. Tweaked enemies’ immunities and weaknesses.
2. Added Enemy Compendium, accessible from the Title Screen or the top bar during battles.
3. Added following cards: 
Military Drill, Explosive Demolition, Tar Everywhere, Tar Gush, Banner, Potted Lily,
Potted Sakura, Potted Tulip, Church, Fair, Clock Tower, Barrel, Wooden Stake,
Training Ground, Cannon Research, Shard Refiner, Venom Extractor
4. Added following Artifacts (formerly “Relics”):
Crescent Dice, Tangram Stone, Hurry Up, Magic Boots, VIP Card, Training Whip, Writing Brush
5. Added following Enchantments: 
Vampiristic, Agile, Air Piercing, Freezing, Burning, Revenge Rage, Death of Phantons, Range of Phantons,
Moldy Garlic, Mechanical Claw, Relict Greataxe, Recurve Bow, The Drifting One, Broken Heart,
Energy Steal, Energy Sucking, Quick Supply, Health Management, Soaring Flames, Weakening,
Firefly Power, Eagle Eye Evolution, Crystal Offence, Shield Absorption, Extra Critical, Repentance,
Lonely Ghost, Energy Shield, Energy Tornado, Energy Charge, Overload, Overheat, PV Efficiency,
Rusty Anchor, Boomerang, Searchlight, Meteoric Mace, Deadly Harpoon, Light Crossbow, Cactus,
Golden Pistol
6. Changed starting Enchantments of most units
7.Tweaked Daily Challenges: More bosses for final waves. Now you can check the info of enemies in a battle before you meet them. Added Daily Faction event and Faction Ban feature.
8. Fixed a bug enabling new zombies to go through walls.
9. Healing Mages won’t overtake ally units engaged in combat.
10. Now you can use the hotkey for Redraw to refresh when selecting cards or enchantments.
11. Fixed a bug where the player can meet the boss from the 7th level of Chapter III in the first level of Chapter I, after Chapter III is cleared.

notes.title: 14th Dec Major update. Version 0.170001
notes.content:
This version adds a lot of new content and gameplay mechanics, and faction enchantment will enrich the gameplay in the middle and late stages of the game.
1. New faction enchantments: Inspiration, Efficient Conversion, Flaming Bow, Arcane Storm, Phantasm Kunai, Summon Osprey, Piercing Rounds, Mighty Lance, Valkyrie.
2.New enchantments: Energy Gain, Tear Through.
3.New daily mission: Mystic Robe, Battlefield Repair.
4.New card: Forbidden Spell.
5.Double click right mouse to order long range units to stand back, click once commands remains unchanged.
6. Increase the range of some long-range units.
7. Reduce the damage of some enemies.
8. New enemy Super Gatling Gun Airship
9. Fix the issue that some shortcut keys and Esc cannot close some interfaces.
10. Fix the issue in the one wave enemy level, after the monsters attack and pick up the treasure box to win directly.
11. Fixed the issue that the game speed doesn't rest to default after the BOSS defeated scene when the card was played. 
12. Monster portrait details show the attack type.
13. Cursed Giant Slime
13. After the Cursed Giant Slime puts a cursed card into the hand, the protection time will be increased by 1 second, during which time the cursed card can no longer be put into the hand.
14. After Mutant Huge Slime forces the player to discard a non-retained hand card, the protection time will be increased by 1 second, during which the player can no longer be forced to discard the hand card.
15. All player units will auto regenerate health.
16. Enchantment UI and background adjustment.

notes.title: Join Us On 'Enter the Dragon'!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

We're excited to be part of Enter the Dragon, an all-new event running from April 22 - 29 celebrating the fantastic games being developed by studios from across the Greater China region. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/39711699/fa4590990479c612111f717d3d708b35a99e87b8.png[/img]

Join us on April 24 at 07:00 am (PDT)/10:00 am (EDT) when we'll be streaming Castle Cardians!

To celebrate this event, we have officially launched the multi-language localization, where you can download and play the game in more native languages (Includes English, Germany, French, Russian, Spanish. We are still polishing the localization, don't worry! We will perfect the localization before the game leave EA status). Hope you'll have a great time playing our game.

Mark your calendars and set your alarms - Enter the Dragon kicks off on April 22 at 19:00(EDT)/22:00(PDT)
